title: Patriots owner Robert Kraft says team has offered CB Christian Gonzalez 'the highest contract' in franchise history

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots owner Robert Kraft says team has offered CB Christian Gonzalez 'the highest contract' in franchise history
sources.description: The offer also reportedly would have exceeded Trent McDuffie's four-year, $124 million deal for the largest cornerback contract in NFL history.
